people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Rehum
people.line: A Persian official who wrote to King Artaxerxes

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

people.name: Shimshai
people.line: Scribe who opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem.

translations.web: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River: Peace.
translations.bsb: Then the king sent this reply: To Rehum the commander, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of your associates living in Samaria and elsewhere in the region west of the Euphrates: Greetings.
translations.kjv: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
translations.asv: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River: Peace, and so forth.
